central_question: Khi nào một ODE có nghiệm, nghiệm có duy nhất và tồn tại toàn cục không, và kỹ thuật nào giữ đúng miền cùng hypotheses?
root_phenomenon: Một luật đạo hàm chỉ xác định evolution đáng tin cậy khi initial data, regularity và continuation conditions được kiểm soát; local existence, uniqueness và global existence là các kết luận khác nhau.
definition: T01 sở hữu ODE, IVP, existence/uniqueness, local-versus-global solution structure, linear/separable forms và qualitative basics; derivative/integral primitives vẫn thuộc C05.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: nhận biết ODE/IVP/equilibrium và local-global distinction.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: áp dụng linear/separable/system transformations với domain checks.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: dùng existence/uniqueness/dependence theorems với hypotheses rõ.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: phê bình overclaim bằng counterexample và missing hypotheses.

counterexamples: Continuity alone does not give uniqueness.
Smoothness alone does not guarantee global existence.
Dividing by h(y) can discard equilibria.
errors_and_limits: C05 owns derivative/integral and multivariable differentiability primitives.
T03 owns flow/orbit language generated from ODE solutions.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: ODE initial-value problems with explicit local/global existence and uniqueness hypotheses
duplicate_fingerprint.learning_meaning: D1-D4 ODE theorem and counterexample reasoning

central_question: PDE type, domain, data và regularity nào cần để existence/uniqueness/solution-principle claim là hợp lệ?
root_phenomenon: PDE solvability phụ thuộc domain, coefficients, initial-boundary data, compatibility và function class chứ không đến từ ký hiệu equation đơn thuần.
definition: T02 sở hữu PDE definition/classification, initial-boundary data và bounded core solution principles với explicit hypotheses, gồm classical/weak distinction; C05 giữ multivariable/functional primitives.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: nhận biết PDE type, domain và data.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: dùng maximum/characteristic principles với hypotheses.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: chứng minh uniqueness và phân biệt weak/classical solutions.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit compatibility, existence, regularity và type-label overclaims.

counterexamples: PDE type alone does not guarantee existence.
Smooth data may lose classical regularity in nonlinear first-order PDE.
Boundary and initial data may be incompatible.
common_misconceptions: Every PDE with boundary data has a classical solution.
errors_and_limits: C05 owns partial derivatives and function-space primitives.
Probability C07 and numerical PDE C10 remain locked and supply no support claims.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: PDE classification and solvability principles with explicit domain/data/regularity hypotheses

central_question: Evolution law tạo map/flow, orbit, invariant set và long-time structure thế nào mà không lẫn representation với dynamics?
root_phenomenon: Iteration hoặc ODE flow tạo quỹ đạo trạng thái; uniqueness, invariance và conjugacy tổ chức qualitative behavior.
definition: T03 sở hữu state evolution, discrete maps, local/global flows, orbit/trajectory, invariant sets, equilibria/fixed points, periodic points, omega-limit và conjugacy meanings; generic maps remain C03-owned.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: nhận biết map/flow/orbit/invariant/periodic structures.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: phân tích invariance, omega-limit và uniqueness consequences.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: justify flow generation và conjugacy with hypotheses.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit autonomous/nonautonomous và local/global overclaims.

knowledge_forming_methods: use ODE uniqueness to build flow
counterexamples: Nonautonomous ODE is not generally autonomous flow on x alone.
Local phase portrait does not establish global existence.
Without uniqueness standard noncrossing can fail.
common_misconceptions: Autonomous and nonautonomous laws have same one-parameter flow on x.
errors_and_limits: C04 geometry supports phase-space representation only.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: state evolution by maps and flows with orbit/invariance/conjugacy semantics
duplicate_fingerprint.learning_meaning: D1-D4 dynamical-system structures and local-global audit

central_question: Những definitions và hypotheses nào cho phép kết luận Lyapunov, asymptotic hoặc exponential stability từ linearization hay Lyapunov functions?
root_phenomenon: Small perturbations may remain small, decay or grow; eigenvalue criteria are decisive only in theorem regimes that justify linearization.
definition: T04 sở hữu Lyapunov/asymptotic/exponential stability, linear criteria, nonlinear linearization và Lyapunov direct methods; eigen/Jacobian primitives được tái dùng từ C03/C05.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: phân biệt stability notions.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: classify linear continuous/discrete spectra including boundary cases.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: use nonlinear linearization only with C1/spectral hypotheses.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit Lyapunov-function signs and attraction/stability distinction.

counterexamples: Attraction is not definitionally identical to stability.
Pure imaginary nonlinear linearization is inconclusive.
V-dot≤0 alone does not prove asymptotic stability.
common_misconceptions: Asymptotic and exponential stability are synonyms.
Eigenvalue signs suffice on the imaginary-axis boundary.
errors_and_limits: C03 owns eigen semantics; C05 owns derivative/Jacobian semantics.
Bifurcation at changing spectral regimes belongs T06.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: stability notions and theorem-limited linearization/Lyapunov criteria

central_question: Khi nào repeated-looking behavior là periodic orbit thật sự, khi nào chỉ transient oscillation, và criterion nào cho periodic dynamics?
root_phenomenon: Exact recurrence defines periodicity; damping/spiral transients can oscillate without repeating; planar recurrence and return maps characterize some periodic orbits.
definition: T05 sở hữu mathematical oscillation/periodic-orbit structure, limit cycles, orbital stability, Poincaré–Bendixson và return-map criteria; physical oscillators/waves are boundary-only examples.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: periodic versus transient oscillation.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: limit-cycle and orbital-stability reasoning.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: Poincaré–Bendixson/return-map theorem use with hypotheses.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit periodicity/Hopf/orbital-stability overclaims.

counterexamples: Decaying sinusoid is not periodic.
Spiral-looking curve does not prove limit cycle.
Periodic orbit does not prove Hopf.
common_misconceptions: Every closed-looking numerical curve is a limit cycle.
Orbital stability means convergence to one phase point.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: periodic solutions and orbital structure distinguished from transient oscillation

central_question: Khi parameter thay đổi, hypotheses nào thực sự cho phép kết luận saddle-node, Hopf, pitchfork, transcritical hay period-doubling?
root_phenomenon: Qualitative structure changes at critical degeneracies; theorem-level local bifurcation claims require spectral, transversality and nondegeneracy conditions.
definition: T06 sở hữu parameter-driven qualitative change, equilibrium continuation/non-bifurcation, local normal forms và hypothesis discipline cho saddle-node/Hopf/period-doubling; T03/T04/C05 supply prerequisites.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: recognize qualitative parameter change and local scope.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: use IFT continuation and scalar normal forms.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: state Hopf/period-doubling spectral, crossing and nondegeneracy hypotheses.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit criticality, stability and local-global conclusions.

counterexamples: Imaginary eigenvalues alone do not prove Hopf.
Pitchfork is not generic without symmetry.
Local normal form does not determine global dynamics.
common_misconceptions: Critical eigenvalue automatically proves named bifurcation.
errors_and_limits: C05 owns IFT/derivative primitives and C03 owns eigen primitives.
Chaos after bifurcation belongs T07; bifurcation is not chaos.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: local bifurcation theory with explicit spectral/transversality/nondegeneracy hypotheses
duplicate_fingerprint.learning_meaning: D1-D4 bifurcation theorem and locality audit

central_question: Properties nào biện minh cho 'chaos', và vì sao sensitivity hoặc một positive numerical diagnostic riêng lẻ không đủ?
root_phenomenon: Deterministic maps/flows can create strong orbit complexity and sensitivity, but chaos definitions are structural and hypothesis-dependent rather than synonyms for randomness or visual irregularity.
definition: T07 sở hữu deterministic chaos, sensitivity, Devaney-style criteria, chaotic invariant sets và Lyapunov-style indicators với scope limits; probability/statistics C07 remains locked.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: define bounded deterministic chaos and distinguish randomness.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: analyze invariant sets, parameter regimes and conjugacy.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: interpret Lyapunov diagnostic without overclaim.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: audit single-diagnostic and visual chaos claims.

examples: chaotic invariant set not automatically attractor
counterexamples: Positive finite-time exponent does not establish universal chaos.
Irregular-looking trajectory is not a chaos definition.
Deterministic chaos is not independent random draws.
common_misconceptions: One Lyapunov estimate proves every orbit chaotic.
One chaotic parameter makes whole family chaotic.
errors_and_limits: C07 probability/statistics is locked; no probabilistic Claim ID is used.
C10 numerical methods are locked; numerical diagnostics are boundary-only cautions.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: deterministic chaos properties with bounded definitions and diagnostic limits
duplicate_fingerprint.learning_meaning: D1-D4 chaos definition and anti-overclaim audit

canonical_name: Mô hình biến đổi theo thời gian
central_question: Một model evolution phải ghi assumptions nào để mathematical conclusions được hiểu đúng và tách khỏi empirical validation?
root_phenomenon: Time-varying models encode state change through continuous/discrete laws, but conclusions are conditional on assumptions, well-posedness and domain of validity.
definition: T08 sở hữu time-evolving model discipline: state/evolution specification, autonomous/nonautonomous forms, extended-state reformulation, well-posedness, conserved quantities và validation boundaries; C07/C10/B1.2 remain locked/boundary-only.

depths.D1: GẶP GỠ: specify state/time/input/law/data and evolution form.
depths.D2: KIẾN TẠO: extended-state, invariant and local-linear reasoning.
depths.D3: HÌNH THỨC HÓA: audit existence/uniqueness/dependence and time-varying structures.
depths.D4: NGHIÊN CỨU & TỔNG HỢP: separate mathematical solution, empirical validation and locked boundary tasks.

counterexamples: Exact solution does not validate model empirically.
Time-dependent model need not inherit autonomous invariants.
Evolution law alone does not supply parameter estimates or simulations.
errors_and_limits: Parameter estimation/statistics C07 and numerical simulation/optimization C10 are locked and provide zero support claims.
Physical/biological/economic semantics in later branches are boundary-only.
evidence_of_understanding: Four D1-D4 objectives are directly semantic-closed by explicit Claim IDs.

duplicate_fingerprint.node_meaning: time-evolving model specification with well-posedness and validation boundaries
duplicate_fingerprint.learning_meaning: D1-D4 model specification and empirical-boundary audit
